> 第11章 活该被咬（第1页）
“呵呵，妈，这傻子泥鳅和蛇都认不清，把泥鳅当蛇了，笑死了。”杨紫暗笑着嘲笑道。
“傻子就是傻子，咱们玩玩他，哈哈。”柳雪怡来了兴趣，说道：“傻春，婶婶跟你打赌，如果里面是蛇，婶婶给你看，如果不是蛇是泥鳅，你就来婶婶的地里干三天活，怎么样？”
“好呀。呵呵。不过我想抓。”柳大春傻笑着说道。
“妈，你太老实了，输了，傻子，按刚才说好的，把脏水喝了，哈哈。”杨紫也不知道是不是口味重还是故意想恶心人，怎么就好这口呢？
“好啊，输了杨紫姐姐你也来喝好吗？你敢不敢啊？”傻大春问道。
“有什么不敢的，还能被你一个傻子给骗了不成？？”杨紫想着，这傻子弱智，很好骗的。
以前骗过好几回了，有一次骗了五块钱，买了辣条，糖果，吃得舒服，那傻子回家被他师娘打哭，哈哈。
杨紫骗傻大春还不只是骗一次，骗了好几次了，都是些恶心又龌龊的事，这次不过是故技重施罢了。
“那你们来，自己摸摸看，是不是蛇？”柳大春把箩筐提了起来，让两个女人自己去摸。
“你个傻子，行。”柳雪怡侧过身子，从旁边游了过去，然后站了起来。
柳大春眼睛看过去，这时婶婶已经背对着自己，丰满的背影看得杨大春深深咽了口气，好看，真是好看呢。
“傻大春，看什么呢，你一个傻子，还懂看女人了？”杨紫大骂了一句。
“呵呵，婶婶好看。”柳大春傻笑着。
那边柳雪怡已经整理好了，走了过来，这个柳雪怡徐老半娘，穿着衬衣，又成熟又知性。
“泥鳅有什么不敢抓的，婶婶经常抓，泥鳅配豆腐，特好吃。”
柳雪怡说着，就把手伸入箩筐里，准备把泥鳅抓出来，好好打一下这个傻子的脸，这个傻子吓唬谁呢，还蛇，泥鳅都不一定有呢。
“啥也没有啊，空的啊，我就说吗，你这个傻子，怎么可能有胆子抓蛇？？”柳雪怡嘚瑟道。
柳大春的话刚说完，柳雪怡似乎抓到了什么东西，拿出来一看，赫然是一头绿色的大竹叶青，正吐着信子朝柳雪怡扑来。

柳雪怡当即吓得惨叫起来，本能的甩掉手上的蛇，连连往后退。
柳雪怡后退着，那竹叶青正好扑在了她的身上，顺着衣袖钻了进去。
“妈，快脱衣服，爬进去了，爬进去了！”
柳雪怡这时也顾不上那么多，急忙去脱外衣。
这一拉，反而一紧，那竹叶青还以为是受到了攻击，当即一口咬了下去。
柳雪怡惨叫起来：“它咬我了！！”
柳大春急忙跑了过去，把外衣急忙给她脱了。

> Chapter 11 Deserve to be bitten (page 1)
"Haha, Mom, this fool can't distinguish between a loach and a snake. He mistook the loach for a snake. He laughed to death." Yang Zi laughed secretly and laughed.
"A fool is a fool, let's play with him, haha." Liu Xueyi became interested and said: "Si Chun, aunt will make a bet with you. If there is a snake inside, aunt will show you. If it is not a snake but a loach, you will come to work in aunt's field for three days. How about it?"
"Okay. Haha. But I want to catch him." Liu Dachun said with a silly smile.
"Mom, you're too honest. You lost. You fool, drink the dirty water as you just promised, haha." Yang Zi didn't know if it was because of the strong taste or because she deliberately wanted to disgust people. Why did she like this mouthful?
"Okay, if you lose, sister Yang Zi, can you come and drink too? Do you dare?" Silly Dachun asked.
"What are you afraid of? How can you be fooled by a fool like you?" Yang Zi thought, this fool is mentally retarded and easy to fool.
I have defrauded him many times before. Once I defrauded him for five yuan and bought spicy strips and candies. I ate them comfortably. The fool went home and was beaten to tears by his wife, haha.
Yang Zi deceived Silly Dachun not just once, but several times. They were all disgusting and dirty things. This time, they were just repeating the same trick.
"Then come here and touch it yourself to see if it's a snake?" Liu Dachun lifted the basket and asked the two women to touch it themselves.
"You idiot, okay." Liu Xueyi turned sideways, swam past, and then stood up.
Liu Dachun looked over. At this time, his aunt's back was turned to him. The plump back made Yang Dachun take a deep breath. It looked good, it looked really good.
"Silly Dachun, what are you looking at? You are a fool, but you still know how to look at women?" Yang Zi cursed.
"Haha, aunt is pretty." Liu Dachun giggled.
Over there, Liu Xueyi had already tidied up and walked over. This old lady, Liu Xueyi and Xu, was wearing a shirt, mature and intellectual.
"If you don't dare to catch loach, my aunt often catches it. Loach with tofu is very delicious."
As Liu Xueyi spoke, she put her hand into the basket, preparing to catch the loach and give this fool a good slap in the face. Who was this fool trying to scare? There might not even be a snake or a loach.
"There's nothing, it's empty, I'm just saying, you idiot, how could you have the guts to catch a snake?" Liu Xueyi said sternly.
Just as Liu Dachun finished speaking, Liu Xueyi seemed to have caught something. When she took it out, she saw that it was a big green bamboo with green leaves, spitting out a message and rushing toward Liu Xueyi.
Liu Xueyi immediately screamed in fright, instinctively shook off the snake in her hand, and stepped back.
Liu Xueyi stepped back, and the bamboo leaf green fell on her body and got in along the sleeves.
"Mom, take off your clothes quickly and crawl in, crawl in!"
Liu Xueyi couldn't care less at this time and hurriedly took off her coat.
This pull led to a tightening. Zhuyeqing thought he was being attacked and immediately bit it.
Liu Xueyi screamed: "It bit me!!"
Liu Dachun hurried over and took off her coat in a hurry.
